h1: Extension integrations for payments, data and email
overview: Your extension often needs to talk to other services, such as a payment provider, an analytics tool, an email list or your own server. We build those connections so they are secure and keep working: keys stay off the user's machine, errors are handled politely and data sent out is kept to what you declare in your store privacy form. You get working connections and a short guide on how they run.

faq: Common ones such as Stripe, Paddle, Google Analytics, Mailchimp, Airtable and REST or GraphQL APIs. If your service has public documentation and allows it, we can usually connect it.
Do I need my own accounts for each service?
Yes. You create the accounts and add us with limited access or send test keys through a safe channel. Fees from those services are billed to you directly.
Is taking payments in an extension allowed?
Yes, when payments run through an outside checkout or licence system and follow the store rules. We build the flow that way and avoid anything that hides charges.
We use a small, low-cost service such as Cloudflare Workers or similar in your account, so you own it. We explain any monthly hosting fee before we build.
